built.heading: Our Methodology. Why It Works.
built.intro: Three millennia of structural human philosophy, calibrated by contemporary interdisciplinary research and translated through an advanced language engine. Designed to empower your core decisions and illuminate cognitive blind spots you cannot navigate alone.
built.easternBody:
For three thousand years, Eastern philosophical traditions have examined time cycles and systemic balance—dissecting choices, direction, and the intrinsic patterns that shape human behavior.

Alignment · Momentum · Reframing · Clarity

These ancient traditions are engineered to help you untangle inner logic and evolutionary paths. They are highly structured cognitive models, iterated over dozens of generations.
built.modernBody:
The empirical regularities observed by ancient traditions are now finding their validation and measurement through the lens of modern science.

Cognitive science in decision framing. Archetypal psychology in spatial awareness. Chronobiology in natural circadian rhythms. Behavioral economics in cognitive biases.

A millennial-tested conceptual framework, now re-examined and verified under the rigor of contemporary research.
built.aiBody:
We harvest the structural data inherent in these ancient calendar systems, cross-reference them with contemporary behavioral insights, and utilize an advanced language engine to translate them into clear, contextual feedback tailored to your unique inquiries.

Not to replace your judgment. To return the cognitive agency back to you.

These tools are engineered exclusively for self-reflection and personal growth exploration — offering thematic frameworks for reference only, never as a substitute for professional diagnosis or deterministic forecasting.
built.closingHeading: This is the core essence of pojulife.
built.closingBody: The essential questions of life deserve nothing less than three thousand years of philosophical reflection, the empirical rigor of modern science, and the precision of a personalized linguistic engine.

what_is.title: What is POJU?
what_is.subtitle: Strategic Decision Core
what_is.body: POJU (Strategic Nexus Unlock) is a high-cognition, conversational cognitive partner engineered to deconstruct complex life dilemmas. Grounded in the systemic architecture of Eastern Five Elements Theory (Wu Xing) and the I Ching, POJU translates over 3,000 years of relational logic into an advanced modern analytical model. By calibrating your precise geographic coordinates and true solar time, the system computes your personalized astro-chronological matrix. When confronting a core strategic bottleneck, POJU serves as your decision-intelligence dashboard—cross-referencing your unique elemental profile with your immediate real-world context. Every session delivers deep behavioral momentum mapping, precise tactical vectors to break deadlocks, and actionable environmental adjustments. This is backed by a 30-day continuous support loop, facilitating dynamic calibration and systemic feedback as your situation evolves.

what_is.title: What is Glyph?
what_is.subtitle: The Metaphorical Mirror
what_is.body: Glyph is an archetypal reflection tool rooted in the I Ching's 64-hexagram situational taxonomy and the Five Elements energy matrix. After mapping your foundational spatiotemporal blueprint, Glyph utilizes a random chaos matrix—aligned with the psychological principle of Synchronicity—via an immersive particle-explosion interface to align your subconscious state with one of 100 classical situational metaphors from Eastern philosophical texts. A deep LLM architecture then seamlessly deconstructs the connection between the metaphor and your personal profile. Glyph strictly avoids deterministic forecasting; instead, it serves as a structured cognitive mirror to transform internal chaos into clear, actionable self-awareness.

what_is.title: What is Syncro?
what_is.subtitle: The Efficiency Map
what_is.body: Syncro is a spatiotemporal efficiency matrix based on the directional logic of the I Ching and the Five Elements framework. By analyzing the energetic alignment between your personal profile and an upcoming task, Syncro charts a comprehensive efficiency map for the next 24 hours. Across 8 spatial directions, it decodes environmental resonance and friction, classifying them into Five Core Currents: Open Current (Move with confidence), Following Current (The way supports you, with effort), Stillwater (Pause and observe), Crosscurrent (Reconsider this direction or moment), and Undertow (Strong friction — recommended to adjust paths). Functioning as a high-precision spatiotemporal weather map, Syncro helps optimize the timing and orientation of crucial endeavors to minimize environmental friction.

what_is.body: Match is an analytical relational matrix grounded in Eastern elemental polarity and Yin-Yang structural balancing. Resolutely rejecting fatalistic compatibility verdicts and fortune-telling, Match deep-dives into the subtle systemic interplay between two independent spatiotemporal blueprints. Applied to specific real-world relationship dynamics—such as core communication styles, professional partnerships, or long-term domestic cooperation—Match maps out mutual resonance zones and potential friction nodes. It operates as a rational coaching framework designed to provide tools for mutual empathy, enabling both parties to build sustainable, constructive structural alignment.

home.faq_q1: What if I don't know the other person's birth time?
home.faq_a1: You can still run a Match with approximate time — accuracy is slightly reduced but the core analysis remains valuable. We use 2-hour windows (Chinese hour periods), so even a rough estimate works.
home.faq_q2: Does the other person need to consent or know?
home.faq_a2: Match is for your understanding. The other person doesn't need to be involved. We never contact them, share their data, or reveal that you ran the reading. Their chart stays on your device only.
home.faq_q3: Can I do more than two people at once?
home.faq_a3: Currently Match focuses on two-person dynamics — this keeps the reading deep and clear. For complex situations (e.g., you + spouse + parent), we suggest running separate Matches to map each relationship cleanly.
home.faq_q4: How is this different from POJU?
home.faq_a4: POJU is a 30-day deep conversation about your situation. Match is a one-time, focused two-chart reading about a specific relationship. Different tools for different needs — many users use both.
home.not_footer: Match offers insight and perspective. What you do with them is entirely yours.
